basic_info.description: Bright and contemporary 2 bedroom, 2 bath condominium with a thoughtful layout and modern updates. The airy and spacious living room features tall ceilings, architectural bay window, custom bookcase and handsome custom fireplace. There is a small tiled balcony off the living room. The updated chef's kitchen with breakfast counter has stainless appliances including gas range, new microwave/hood, dishwasher and refrigerator. The adjoining light-filled dining room has modern lighting and bay window. Two spacious rear bedrooms. The primary has a walk-in closet and designer carpet. The primary bath has a large glass enclosed shower and modern vanity. The second hall bathroom features custom tile and a shower over the bathtub. In-unit laundry closet with stacking washer/dryer. Elevator in building. One car deeded garage and storage room. There is a serene, shared garden and patio. Prime location with everything NOPA and Anza Vista close by. 1/2 block to all the shopping, dining and cafe's along Divisadero Street and close to Alamo Square and the Panhandle. Easy Access to MUNI and shuttles
